info.title: skyatlaz-service
info.description: The SkyAtlaz service: it holds the Hypixel developer key and answers the profile of the player that asks for it. The mod signs a challenge with its Minecraft profile key pair and gets a token that only works for that player, so there is no endpoint that reads the profile of somebody else.

servers.description: The default local address. The mod reads it from the setting general.service_url.

rate_limit.description: How many requests the key may do in the window, and how many are left.

cache.description: How many profiles the cache holds right now, so the memory use can be watched.

get.summary: The counters, in the Prometheus text format.
get.description: Aggregates only: no token, no uuid and no profile crosses this answer. Routes and statuses are counted under fixed names, so a caller cannot make a series of its own, and no counter is per player.

200.description: One series per line, in the text exposition format version 0.0.4.

get.summary: Hands out a single use nonce that the client has to sign.

429.description: The same address asked for more challenges than it is allowed in a minute. The answer carries Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: How many seconds to wait before asking again.

post.summary: Verifies the signed challenge and hands out a session token.
post.description: The client sends the nonce it got, the signature of the nonce made with the private half of the Minecraft profile key pair, the public key and the signature Mojang produced over it. The public key signature binds the key to the uuid, so the token belongs to that player and to nobody else.

401.description: The challenge or the signatures are not valid.

get.summary: The profile of the player that owns the token.

401.description: The token is missing or expired.

404.description: The player has no SkyBlock profile the service can read.

502.description: The Hypixel API could not be read: a 5xx, a network error, a timeout or an answer that is not the expected JSON. The cause is logged, not returned.

503.description: The key used up its Hypixel rate limit. The answer carries Retry-After with the seconds to wait.

Retry-After.description: How many seconds to wait before asking again.

nonce.description: Base64 of 32 random bytes. The client signs these bytes with the private profile key.

expires_at.description: When the nonce stops being valid, in milliseconds since the epoch.

uuid.description: The uuid of the player, with or without dashes.

public_key.description: Base64 of the DER encoded public key of the profile key pair.

public_key_signature.description: Base64 of the signature Mojang produced over the public key.

expires_at.description: When the profile key expires, in milliseconds since the epoch.

nonce.description: The nonce of the challenge, unchanged.

signature.description: Base64 of the signature of the nonce bytes, made with the private profile key.

token.description: The bearer token of the profile endpoint.

expires_at.description: When the token expires, in milliseconds since the epoch.

SlimProfile.description: The profile of the player, reduced to what the features need.

name.description: The name of the player, when the API reports it.

dungeons.description: The dungeon statistics, passed through as the API sends them.

currencies.description: The currencies of the player, passed through as the API sends them.

fetched_at.description: When the service fetched the profile, in milliseconds since the epoch.

MiningProfile.description: The state of the mining tree.

perks.description: The level of every perk of the tree, keyed by the perk id.

toggles.description: Whether every perk is toggled on, keyed by the perk id.

ability.description: The pickaxe ability that is currently selected.

powder.description: The mined powder amounts, keyed by the powder id.
